title: 小六六对话配图：访客来之前
audio_introduction: Listen to dialogues A to F. Match all six pictures to dialogues.
instruction: 听A—F六段完整对话，为全部6幅图各选相符对话的字母。没有额外规定每字母只能用一次。原卷未印遍数/时序；本机全组一遍、前后各15秒，可重播，不当原卷规则。
source_form_notice: 小六公开东城区期末原页完整六对话A—F配六图已核，正文有区/学年/学期，原校施测未认证；源音轨/脚本/键缺、遍数及复用未知。本稿完整原创对话，配套图复用自有已核几何图，不当18独立主题/曝光或儿童识图、独立难度验证。
teacher_source_notice:

每个标号后有完整M/W问答，六段合为一个完整大题/六回应，不算六套。完整源角色与键不凭无录音的图猜。源复用次数未印，本稿不加每项一次；无复用冲突扣分。三个版本共18图位复用12个自有单场景图，只有对话/组合新编，主题与视觉曝光不独立。脚本默认隐藏；本机合成不当源gold、独立教研、学生、商用或生产通过。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Have you finished the message for the visitors?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Not quite. I am writing the last line on this paper, then I will leave it at the desk.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You are wearing a cook's hat. Are you making lunch?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes. I am stirring the soup in the pot. The visitors will eat after their tour.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: How are you getting to the meeting point?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: On my bicycle. I am riding there now, so I do not miss the start.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: What are you holding open in front of you?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: A book about the town. I am reading a page before I show the visitors around.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Where are you taking that large box?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I am carrying it to the storeroom. These things must be put away before everyone arrives.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Are you filling the pot at that sink?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. I am washing my hands. I have just finished moving the dusty chairs.
